name: グループ作成後の会話案内パネル
prompt:
Create a crisp, flat Japanese chat screen screenshot at exactly 390×632. Use the native 390×632 preview for exact structure, geometry, wording, and proportions. Use the prior no-tint group card candidate to carry its agreed neutral surface treatment and blue hyperlink color. Use the original source crop only for context. Keep the native Japanese adaptation: use the 光 monogram circles and do not copy the source Statue of Liberty artwork, English wording, or patterned wallpaper.

User-directed color rule for this screen: no tinted fills and no green accents. Use a white (#FFFFFF) page background. All surfaces, including the two avatar circles, 今日 badge, central card, action pills, and conversation-protection panel, must be white with thin neutral light-gray outlines (#E8ECE9). No mint, pastel, beige, green, gradient, shadow, or other colored fill. Render the camera and phone icons in dark neutral (#1D1D1D). Make monograms and button labels dark neutral (#1D1D1D); title text dark neutral and secondary captions gray (#6E6E6E). The standalone action 説明を追加 must be blue (#1976D2) as the user requested for hyperlink-looking text. In the bottom notice, keep its first two lines neutral and make only 詳しく見る blue (#1976D2) as the learn-more hyperlink. Blue links are the only colored text.

Preserve these exact native strings and placements:
- Header: avatar 光 at x24 y10 40×40; title 地域のなかま at x80 y8, 14px bold; subtitle タップしてグループ情報を見る at x80 y36, 12px gray; camera icon x310 y25 about 21×16; phone icon x351 y22 about 22×21.
- Today badge at x160 y90 70×32, label 今日 centered.
- Main card at x24 y148 342×330 with 12px corners; inner avatar 光 at x164 y164 62×62; heading グループを作成しました at x40 y256 310×28, 20px bold; subtitle グループ・メンバー3人 at x40 y296 310×24, 14px regular; blue action 説明を追加 at x40 y338 310×24, 14px bold; white outlined pills メンバーを追加 at x40 y384 310×32 and リンクやコードで招待 at x40 y430 310×32, 12px regular.
- Conversation-protection panel at x42 y516 306×92 with 8px corners and neutral outline. Text at x58 y532, 274×48, 12px Meiryo-like regular, three lines exactly: メッセージと通話は暗号化されます。 / この会話の参加者だけが閲覧できます。 / 詳しく見る. The final line is blue.

Do not add controls, icons inside the two action pills, wallpaper, illustrations, extra text, or decorative accents. Maintain clean readable Japanese typography, compact spacing, neutral materials, and exact 390×632 composition. No device frame.
reviewNotes: No tinted surfaces or green accents; only the two requested semantic hyperlinks are blue. Needs-correction: central card is about 36px too tall, card actions are 24-34px too low, avatar/date badge and typography are oversized versus the 390x632 native preview.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
